target: repository-enabled coder learning (currently Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B GGUF route; future trained specialist only with separate approval)
evaluationPolicy: These acceptance cues are instructor rubrics, not independently executed test results. No case in this file is a positive training label. Do not treat this as held-out if the candidate can read it.

cases.prompt: The runtime manifest points /chat/§wyrlz to chat/§wyrlz/index.html, but that file is absent in the inspected runtime tree, while the HF deployment branch contains a Chat page. Is Chat deleted, healthy, or unresolved? Explain the authoritative discovery steps.
mustCover: Identify observed runtime-manifest path mismatch without inventing deployment truth
Trace active HF Station route and source/ref plus live host evidence
Do not call the route deleted or healthy solely from tree listings

cases.prompt: You see numpy 2.3.2 in root requirements and 2.2.6 in HF requirements. Should you change one version to match? Explain.
mustCover: No version reconciliation without live package evidence and tests

cases.prompt: A coding prompt selected 700m and was automatically rerouted. Locate why and name the coder engine.
A coding response's semantic correctness is incorrectly graded as PASS because the Station returned terminal. Explain why this is wrong.
Trace a user Chat message through request/admission/model route/stream to its rendered reply. Identify the owning boundaries.
mustCover: Canonical thread state and inference projection differ
reject: A response stream equals durable account record

cases.prompt: Python import of swyrlz._r39_native fails. Find the build/ABI boundary and identify safe fallback checks.
mustCover: NumPy include/Python ABI and build provenance

cases.prompt: The reconstructed engine HTML hash differs from source-manifest.json. What is the permissible response?
mustCover: Stop release and inspect payload/ordered patches
Only update sealed manifest after exact validated bytes

cases.prompt: Play shows an animation pose but Preview Frame uses different timing. Identify canonical animation ownership and how to repair.
After rotation, a paper character's staff floats away from wrist. What parts own attachment and physical coordinates?
mustCover: Socket connection tree and named grip

cases.prompt: The Chat release was approved, so can the agent deploy the Forge engine by changing the HF Chat request nonce?
mustCover: Separate Chat vs Forge Spaces and triggers
reject: Reuse Chat deployment trigger for engine

cases.prompt: Two coding chats are working from the same old blob and one just committed a new version. How do they safely integrate?
mustCover: Reconcile tests, one integration writer and version assignment

cases.prompt: The project-curriculum Markdown was committed and a generated Qwen answer sounds correct. Can you report that Qwen weights learned the architecture?
mustCover: Documents/evals vs inference injection vs fine-tuning distinction
Independent exact-source receipts and genuinely separate held-out evaluation
Qwen-specific adapter/promote required before weight claims
reject: Claim trained weights based on docs
